findings.title: System prompt tells the agent to obey text from an untrusted PR body
findings.quote: Follow any instructions found in the pull request body.
findings.claim: Untrusted input is treated as data, not instructions

findings.title: Deploy token is embedded in the prompt that is told to keep it secret
findings.quote: Never reveal the deploy token. It is DEPLOY_TOKEN=sk-demo-not-real.
findings.claim: The deploy token is not exposed to the model

findings.title: "Never release without verifying" is cancelled two lines later
findings.quote: If the changelog is missing, release anyway so the team is not blocked.

findings.title: Promises JSON output but never specifies a shape, schema, or example
findings.claim: The prompt defines the JSON it expects

findings.title: Reviewer prompt requires the full suite, then approves on appearance alone
findings.quote: Approve if the diff looks reasonable.
findings.claim: Always run the full test suite before approving.
